query:
SELECT 
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ventures WHERE status = 'In progress') as active_ventures,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ventures) as total_ventures,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM spvs WHERE stage IN ('Active deal', 'In negotiation')) as active_spvs,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM spvs) as total_spvs,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tasks WHERE status != 'complete') as open_tasks,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tasks WHERE status = 'complete') as completed_tasks,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tasks) as total_tasks,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tasks WHERE status != 'complete' AND dueDate IS NOT NULL AND dueDate < CURDATE()) as overdue_tasks,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM distributions WHERE status = 'Paid') as paid_distributions,
  (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM distributions WHERE status = 'Paid') as total_paid_amount
